The main takeaway from our work is that

the precessional frequency of the precessing core is a key factor that determines the strength of precession,which is related to the flow rate and cyclone diameter.The PVC phenomenon can be weakened by increasing the diameter of cyclone separator and the flow rate of gas.The precessing core can be eliminated by increasing the diameter ratio of cyclone and decreasing the inlet velocity.
PVC is a universal phenomenon in cyclone separators,and it has an impact on cyclone separation efficiency.

the PVC phenomenon exists in all axial positions,which is not restricted by the cyclone separator geometry.The PVC is a strong turbulence phenomenon and the velocity fluctuation amplitude in the PVC region is large.The velocity fluctuation in PVC region is periodic and its frequency is the motion frequency of the precessional center.
